title: Stationary Storage Type Electric Water Heaters- Specification (Fifth Revision)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard cover general safety and performance requirements of Stationary Storage Type Electric Water Heater for household and similar purpose. 1.2 In addition to the above 1.1 of IS : 302-2-21 ( 1992 ) is applicable.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Stationary Storage Type Electric Water Heaters- Specification (Fifth Revision) (IS 2082 (PART 1))
Indian Standard Code of Practice / Test Method (IS 302)
Indian Standard Code of Practice / Test Method (IS 20)

clause_3_terminology: Stationary Storage Type Electric Water Heaters

marking_requirements: Each product/package must bear the manufacturer's name, trademark, and grade.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS ISI Mark) subject to licensing.
